topic: Scopper Gaban's feats on Elbaph, including landing a hit on Nerona Imu and revealing Zoro's Supreme King Haki, prove he really was the Roger Pirates' second strongest member, not their third
title: Scopper Gaban Really Was Roger's Second Strongest Pirate
description:
Even the giants on Elbaph rank Scopper Gaban third strongest of the Roger Pirates, and Gaban furiously corrects them every single time. This is the chapter-cited case for why he's actually right: from clearing a mountain range with two axes to landing a hit on the World Government's secret ruler in single combat, Gaban's resume stacks up directly against Rayleigh's own.

From the Battle of Edd War to the warning he gave Zoro about his own hidden Haki, this traces exactly why Gaban deserves the rank he's spent his whole life fighting for.
